steps.why: walking docs/ for .md files and pulling each relative link with its file and line is a fixed parse; two runs must produce the identical inventory

proposed_script.name: collect_links.py
proposed_script.stdout: counts only: files scanned, links found, anchor-only links skipped
proposed_script.exit: 0 links found / 1 no markdown files under the root / 2 usage or unreadable root

steps.why: a link is broken exactly when its resolved path is absent from disk; the counts are arithmetic, so no run should differ

proposed_script.name: resolve_links.py
proposed_script.stdout: broken count / total count, then one line per broken link: source:line -> target
proposed_script.exit: 0 all links resolve / 1 broken links found / 2 usage or unreadable input

steps.why: the release deadline arrives from the conversation, not from disk, so reasonable runs should rank the same broken links differently; resolve_links.py already supplies the candidate list and exit 1 gates whether this step runs at all
